attchmntText: Brooks Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- Revision
voiceSummary: Brooks Laboratories Limited has received an upgrade in its credit ratings from CARE Ratings Limited. The long-term bank facilities rating is upgraded to CARE BB plus with a stable outlook, from CARE BB. The short-term bank facilities rating is upgraded to CARE A4 plus, from CARE A4. The upgrade follows the receipt of Rs. 106.33 crore from the partial divestment of its stake in Brooks Steriscience Limited. This capital infusion strengthens the company's liquidity and financial risk profile. Contingent liabilities have reduced to approximately Rs. 48.15 crore. Profit before interest, lease rentals, depreciation and taxation margin improved to 8.88 percent in FY26. The company plans to use the funds for capital expenditure. A proposed demerger of the manufacturing business into Abridge Speciality Limited is also noted.

attchmntText: Brooks Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Brooks Laboratories Limited has filed an intimation pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements Regulations 2015. The company published extracts of newspaper publications in Financial Express and Jansatta on 08th November 2026. These publications relate to the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The filing was signed by Bhushan Singh Rana, Whole Time Director, with DIN 10289384. The document serves as information and record for BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.

attchmntText: Brooks Laboratories Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Brooks Laboratories Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 07th November 2026. The company reported a net profit of 6,998.82 lakhs for the quarter and 6,761.00 lakhs for the half year. This performance includes an exceptional gain of 7,470.00 lakhs resulting from the partial divestment of its stake in Brooks Steriscience Limited. The company sold 36,000 equity shares, representing 11.48% of the investee's capital, for an aggregate consideration of 7,473.60 lakhs. Following this transaction, the company retains a 37.52% equity stake in Brooks Steriscience Limited. Revenue from operations stood at 1,924.79 lakhs for the quarter and 4,220.87 lakhs for the half year. The financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and are available on the company website.
